objects.description: Opaque handle to a headset instance used with the C API. It represents an internal C++ object; users only pass it to API functions and must not dereference it. Instances are discovered by hsc_discover and released with hsc_free_headsets.
Result/error code enum returned by most API functions. Non-negative indicates success; negative values indicate specific failure reasons.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
    HSC_CAP_SIDETONE                       = 0,
    HSC_CAP_BATTERY_STATUS                 = 1,
    HSC_CAP_NOTIFICATION_SOUND             = 2,
    HSC_CAP_LIGHTS                         = 3,
    HSC_CAP_INACTIVE_TIME                  = 4,
    HSC_CAP_CHATMIX_STATUS                 = 5,
    HSC_CAP_VOICE_PROMPTS                  = 6,
    HSC_CAP_ROTATE_TO_MUTE                 = 7,
    HSC_CAP_EQUALIZER_PRESET               = 8,
    HSC_CAP_EQUALIZER                      = 9,
    HSC_CAP_PARAMETRIC_EQUALIZER           = 10,
    HSC_CAP_MICROPHONE_MUTE_LED_BRIGHTNESS = 11,
    HSC_CAP_MICROPHONE_VOLUME              = 12,
    HSC_CAP_VOLUME_LIMITER                 = 13,
    HSC_CAP_BT_WHEN_POWERED_ON             = 14,
    HSC_CAP_BT_CALL_VOLUME                 = 15,
    HSC_NUM_CAPABILITIES                   = 16,
} hsc_capability_t;
objects.description: Enum of feature capabilities a headset may support. Used with hsc_supports and as indices for capability-related queries.
Enum describing battery status conditions and sentinel values used alongside percentage/metrics.
Battery information structure filled by hsc_get_battery, including percentage, status, voltage, and time estimates. Callers allocate and pass a pointer for output.
Optional result structure returned by hsc_set_sidetone providing the applied level and supported range.
Structure holding chat-mix status values filled by hsc_get_chatmix.
Optional result structure for hsc_set_inactive_time indicating the applied timeout and supported range.

functions.name: hsc_discover
functions.description: Discovers connected USB headsets and allocates an array of opaque headset handles. The array must be released with hsc_free_headsets(). Returns the number of headsets found, or a negative error code.
requirements: headsets must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the allocated array pointer.
Caller must free the returned array with hsc_free_headsets(headsets, count) where count is the returned number.
Caller must handle negative return values as errors and must not call hsc_free_headsets if discovery failed (negative count).
Returned handles are opaque and should only be used with this API; do not dereference or free individual handles.

functions.name: hsc_free_headsets
functions.signature: HSC_API void hsc_free_headsets(hsc_headset_t* headsets, int count)
functions.description: Frees the array of headset handles previously returned by hsc_discover(). Does not return a value.
requirements: headsets must be the exact array pointer previously returned by hsc_discover() (or NULL if count is 0).
count must be the number returned by hsc_discover() for that array (0 allowed).
Must not be called on an array more than once.
Do not use any handles from the array after calling this function.

functions.name: hsc_version
functions.description: Returns the library version string. The returned string is owned by the library and must not be freed.
requirements: Return value is a null-terminated string that must not be freed or modified by the caller.
May be called at any time; no initialization required.

functions.name: hsc_supported_device_count
functions.description: Returns the number of device types the library supports.
requirements: Return value is non-negative; treat negative values as errors only if documented elsewhere (no errors documented here).
Use the returned count to bound indices passed to hsc_supported_device_name().

functions.name: hsc_supported_device_name
functions.description: Returns the name of a supported device type by index. The string is owned by the library and must not be freed. Returns NULL if index is out of range.
requirements: index must be in the range [0, hsc_supported_device_count()-1] to get a non-NULL result.
Do not free or modify the returned string.
Caller must check for NULL to handle out-of-range indices.

functions.name: hsc_get_name
functions.description: Returns the device name for the given headset. The string is owned by the library and must not be freed.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Do not free or modify the returned string.

functions.name: hsc_get_vendor_id
functions.description: Returns the USB vendor ID for the given headset.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().

functions.name: hsc_get_product_id
functions.description: Returns the USB product ID for the given headset.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().

functions.name: hsc_supports
functions.signature: HSC_API bool hsc_supports(hsc_headset_t headset, hsc_capability_t cap)
functions.description: Checks whether the given headset supports a specific capability.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
cap must be a valid hsc_capability_t value.

functions.name: hsc_get_capabilities
functions.description: Returns a bitmask of supported capabilities for the given headset.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller must interpret the returned int as a bitmask corresponding to hsc_capability_t values.

functions.name: hsc_get_battery
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_get_battery(hsc_headset_t headset, hsc_battery_t* battery)
functions.description: Retrieves battery information for the headset, filling the provided hsc_battery_t with level, status, voltage, and time estimates. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
battery must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable hsc_battery_t.
Caller must check the return value for HSC_RESULT_OK before using output fields.
Some fields may be -1 when not available, as documented in hsc_battery_t.

functions.name: hsc_get_chatmix
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_get_chatmix(hsc_headset_t headset, hsc_chatmix_t* chatmix)
functions.description: Retrieves the chat-mix state, populating the provided hsc_chatmix_t with overall level and calculated game/chat percentages. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
chatmix must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable hsc_chatmix_t.
Caller must check the return value for HSC_RESULT_OK before using output fields.

functions.name: hsc_set_sidetone
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_sidetone(hsc_headset_t headset, uint8_t level, hsc_sidetone_t* result)
functions.description: Sets the sidetone level of the headset. Optionally returns min/max/current levels in result. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
level must be in the range 0–128 (0 = off).
result may be NULL; if non-NULL it must point to writable memory.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_SIDETONE) to avoid HSC_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: hsc_set_volume_limiter
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_volume_limiter(hsc_headset_t headset, bool enabled)
functions.description: Enables or disables the headset's volume limiter. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_VOLUME_LIMITER) to avoid unsupported operations.

functions.name: hsc_set_equalizer_preset
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_equalizer_preset(hsc_headset_t headset, uint8_t preset)
functions.description: Selects a built-in equalizer preset by preset ID. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
preset must be a valid preset index for the device; callers can query range via hsc_get_equalizer_presets_count().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_EQUALIZER_PRESET).

functions.name: hsc_set_equalizer
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_equalizer(hsc_headset_t headset, const float* bands, int num_bands)
functions.description: Applies a custom equalizer curve specified by an array of band values. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
If num_bands > 0, bands must be a non-NULL pointer to an array of at least num_bands floats.
num_bands must be non-negative.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_EQUALIZER) or HSC_CAP_PARAMETRIC_EQUALIZER depending on device.

functions.name: hsc_get_equalizer_presets_count
functions.description: Returns the number of built-in equalizer presets supported by the device, or 0 if not supported.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
A return value of 0 indicates no presets or unsupported feature; treat negative values as errors only if documented elsewhere (no errors documented here).

functions.name: hsc_set_mic_volume
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_mic_volume(hsc_headset_t headset, uint8_t volume)
functions.description: Sets the microphone volume level. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
volume must be in the range 0–128.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_MICROPHONE_VOLUME).

functions.name: hsc_set_mic_mute_led_brightness
functions.description: Sets the brightness of the microphone mute LED. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
brightness must be in the range 0–3.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_MICROPHONE_MUTE_LED_BRIGHTNESS).

functions.name: hsc_set_rotate_to_mute
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_rotate_to_mute(hsc_headset_t headset, bool enabled)
functions.description: Enables or disables the rotate-to-mute feature. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_ROTATE_TO_MUTE).

functions.name: hsc_set_lights
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_lights(hsc_headset_t headset, bool enabled)
functions.description: Turns the headset lighting on or off. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_LIGHTS).

functions.name: hsc_set_voice_prompts
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_voice_prompts(hsc_headset_t headset, bool enabled)
functions.description: Enables or disables voice prompts on the headset. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_VOICE_PROMPTS).

functions.name: hsc_play_notification_sound
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_play_notification_sound(hsc_headset_t headset, uint8_t sound_id)
functions.description: Plays a notification sound identified by sound_id. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
sound_id must be a valid identifier supported by the device.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_NOTIFICATION_SOUND).

functions.name: hsc_set_inactive_time
functions.signature: HSC_API hsc_result_t hsc_set_inactive_time(hsc_headset_t headset, uint8_t minutes, hsc_inactive_time_t* result)
functions.description: Sets the auto power-off timeout. Optionally returns min/max/current minutes in result. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
minutes is in minutes; 0 disables auto power-off (per documentation).
result may be NULL; if non-NULL it must point to writable memory.
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_INACTIVE_TIME).

functions.name: hsc_set_bluetooth_when_powered_on
functions.description: Configures whether Bluetooth is enabled when the headset powers on. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_BT_WHEN_POWERED_ON).

functions.name: hsc_set_bluetooth_call_volume
functions.description: Sets the Bluetooth call volume level. Returns HSC_RESULT_OK on success, negative error code on failure.
requirements: headset must be a valid handle obtained from hsc_discover().
volume must be within the device-accepted range (exact range unknown; not specified).
Caller should check capability via hsc_supports(headset, HSC_CAP_BT_CALL_VOLUME).

functions.name: hsc_enable_test_device
functions.description: Enables or disables the Test device mode. When enabled, hsc_discover() includes a synthetic HeadsetControl Test device (0xF00B:0xA00C) even without physical hardware.
requirements: Can be called at any time before hsc_discover() to affect discovery results.
enabled selects whether the test device is included.

functions.name: hsc_is_test_device_enabled
functions.description: Returns whether Test device mode is currently enabled.
requirements: No preconditions; may be called at any time.

functions.name: hsc_set_device_timeout
functions.description: Sets the HID device read timeout in milliseconds. Default is 5000 ms if not changed.
requirements: timeout_ms is a duration in milliseconds; must be non-negative to avoid undefined behavior (exact constraints not specified).
Call affects subsequent HID read operations globally.

functions.name: hsc_get_device_timeout
functions.description: Returns the current HID device timeout in milliseconds.
requirements: No preconditions; may be called at any time.

functions.name: hsc_set_test_profile
functions.description: Sets the behavior profile for the HeadsetControl Test device. See external documentation for profile numbers; 0 = normal.
requirements: profile is an integer profile selector; valid values follow external documentation (exact range not specified).
Affects behavior when Test device mode is used.

functions.name: hsc_get_test_profile
functions.description: Returns the current HeadsetControl Test device profile number.
requirements: No preconditions; may be called at any time.
